{{Quote|No, we're not here for drinks. We have business with Garsa Fwip.|Fennec Shand, to the droid|<ref name="Chapter 1" />}}
'''B5-R4'''<ref name="Toy">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=B5-R4 · R0-1N6 · GS-C1B · J7R-T|altlink=https://yakfaceforums.com/main/2025/04/11/tbobf-droidfactory-set-revealed}}</ref> was an [[R4 astromech droid]] who worked for [[Garsa Fwip]] at her [[cantina]], the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]], on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], serving drinks for patrons during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Chapter 1" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[droid]] was present in the establishment and offered<ref name="Chapter 1" /> the newcomers,<ref name="Chapter 1 AD">{{BOBF|Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> recent [[Daimyo]] of Tatooine [[Boba Fett]] and [[Master Assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]], drinks from their tray harness. Shand informed the droid they did not need beverages and had business with the owner, Fwip, leaving B5-R4 to respond before rolling away.<ref name="Chapter 1" />[[Time|Sometime]] later,<ref name="Date" /> the droid observed the [[Wookiee]]<ref name="Chapter 4">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}}</ref> [[bounty hunter]]<ref name="Krrsantan">{{Databank|krrsantan|Krrsantan}}</ref> [[Krrsantan]] engage in a brawl with several [[Trandoshan]] [[gambler]]s in the Sanctuary, leaving Fwip to attempt to calm the hostile Krrsantan, which ended poorly for [[Unidentified Trandoshan gambler|one]] of the Trandoshans who had<ref name="Chapter 4" /> his<ref name="Chapter 4 AD">{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Limb|arm]] severed.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

Later on, the droid continued to display drinks for patrons and rolled around the Sanctuary when two [[Pyke Syndicate]] members entered the cantina before<ref name="Chapter 6">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}</ref> swiftly<ref name="Chapter 6 AD">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> exiting shortly thereafter, leaving behind a [[camtono]] on a table. A [[GS-C1B|server droid]] attempted to call towards the [[Pyke]]s to alert them of their lost item, which [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|exploded]] moments after, [[Death|killing]] all present in the Sanctuary including B5-R4.<ref name="Chapter 6" /> The droid had [[Color|green]] and black plating along with black [[photoreceptor]]s and wore a drink tray harness while inside the Sanctuary.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
B5-R4 first appeared in the [[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land|premiere episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which aired<ref name="Chapter 1" /> on [[December 29]], [[2021]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="Disney+">{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}}</ref> The droid was not identified in the series, but received a name in a four-figure [[2025]] [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'' toy line]] set centered around ''The Book of Boba Fett'', with one figure being B5-R4.<ref name="Toy" />
